Throttling is a guide

CPU throttling

  • Slows your CPU by a factor
  • Good for finding long tasks

Not a real phone

  • Relative to your computer
  • Field data shows real users

Use throttling to find problems, not to promise numbers.

Four rules connect everything you tried in this lab.

Live metrics spot the problem.

A trace shows each task.

A task over 50 milliseconds is a long task.

Yielding splits long work.

At 4x in our example,

one big task made a second click wait 135 milliseconds.

Four yielding pieces cut it to 15.

Throttling slows your own computer.

It cannot copy a real phone,

so check field data when you can.
